publication_write_rule: Any PR that changes runtime operational publication authority for a task MUST update research_task_heads/<task_id>.json in the same PR. Use `python control_plane/research_task_head_serialization.py sync --task-id <TASK_ID>` after creating or selecting the immutable operational publication record.
parallel_publication_rule: Non-operational parallel publications may coexist as immutable research evidence under the parallel-intake contract. They do not receive additional runtime head pointers merely because they remain epistemically live.
rule: Every task with a selected runtime operational publication authority has exactly one deterministic per-task head pointer. Concurrent same-task attempts to change that operational authority contend on one Git path instead of silently producing two runtime heads; research evidence may remain parallel without creating a second operational head.
